halt_handoff.text:
Loop 2 ended at HALT_SUCCESS — every scorecard category is at 10 or 9.5+ with an accepted residual. The codebase meets the contest target.

Final scorecard:
  - Architecture quality: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - State management: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Domain modeling: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Data flow: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Framework idioms: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Concurrency: 10
  - Simplicity: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Test strategy: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Credibility: 9.5 (accepted residual)

Accepted residuals (won't be revisited unless you ask):
  - architecture_quality: HeadToHeadPage.tsx ~450 lines — within accepted complexity for a page-level orchestrator.
  - state_management: Undo history capped at 20 snapshots — deliberate product decision.
  - domain_modeling: Item.status plain string (not enum) — acceptable for a user-defined label.
  - data_flow: urlSharing.ts encodes only image/gif media as compact.u — intentional lossy encode for URL length.
  - framework_idioms: ItemModal.tsx mediaType form-value type cast — safe given controlled input constraints.
  - simplicity: headToHead.ts ~1356 lines — substantive algorithm, passes deletion test.
  - test_strategy: No Playwright E2E for ItemMedia rendering paths — unit tests cover the discriminated union exhaustively.
  - credibility: useItemForm.ts local mediaType state string default 'image' — UI-only concern.

Findings resolved this run:
  - F-001 (loop 1): onboardingSlice reducer-body localStorage I/O — moved into createPersistenceMiddleware.
  - F-002 (loop 1): dynamic require() for vote + unused clearDeferredPairs import — replaced with static import.
  - F-003 (loop 2): Item allowed impossible multi-URL combinations — replaced 4 parallel URL fields with media?: ItemMedia discriminated union; 18 reader/writer sites updated; net deletion.

Tests: 239/239 pass across 36 suites. Tree clean.

Next step options:
  (a) Tag the commit (03e21db, or d57e96d for the registry SHA backfill) and move on.
  (b) Spot-check one accepted residual — say "verify <category>" and I'll re-read the cited source.
  (c) Reset and run again from current source — type "/contest-refactor --reset" (useful if the codebase has changed materially since this halt).

verdict_explanation: All three prior findings resolved. Post-loop-2, Item's impossible multi-URL state is eliminated at the type level via a discriminated union (ItemMedia). The persistence seam, H2H algorithm, and selector graph remain intact. All 239 tests pass. No open findings. All 9 dimensions at 9.5 with accepted residuals only.

architecture_quality.proof: F-001 resolved loop 1: onboardingSlice reducer-body I/O removed; createPersistenceMiddleware now sole persistence authority. F-003 resolved loop 2: Item model no longer admits impossible multi-URL combos. Module graph: packages/core has zero React deps; packages/state depends only on @tiercade/core. Dependency inversion enforced throughout.
architecture_quality.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: HeadToHeadPage.tsx ~450 lines — approaching single-responsibility threshold but does not cross it; within accepted complexity for a page-level orchestrator.

state_management.proof: F-001 resolved loop 1: onboarding no longer writes localStorage inside reducers. F-002 resolved loop 1: dynamic require() replaced with static import. All state mutations go through Redux actions. createSelector memoization consistent. updateItem accepts Partial<Item> — compatible with new ItemMedia union field.
state_management.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Undo history capped at 20 snapshots by trim logic in undoRedoSlice — deliberate product decision, not a state management flaw.

domain_modeling.proof: F-003 resolved loop 2: Item.imageUrl/videoUrl/audioUrl/mediaType removed; replaced by media?: ItemMedia where ItemMedia = { type: 'image'|'gif'; url: string } | { type: 'video'; url: string } | { type: 'audio'; url: string }. Impossible multi-URL state unrepresentable. createItem factory simplified from 12 lines to 6. filtering.ts getItemMediaType reduced from 10 lines to 1.
domain_modeling.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Item.status field is a plain string (not an enum) — acceptable for a user-defined label; no invariant violation.

data_flow.proof: F-001 resolved loop 1: onboardingSlice back-channel eliminated. All data flows are now explicit dispatch → reducer → selector → component. modelResolver.ts resolvedItemToItem constructs ItemMedia correctly (type: 'image', url: thumbUri). No ambient state reads.
data_flow.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: URL sharing (urlSharing.ts) encodes only image/gif media as compact.u — intentional lossy encode for URL-length reasons; documented in-file.

framework_idioms.proof: F-001 resolved loop 1: reducer side effects eliminated. F-002 resolved loop 1: ESM dynamic require() replaced with static import. createSlice, createSelector, createAsyncThunk used throughout. useId() for SSR-safe IDs. React 19 functional components only.
framework_idioms.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: ItemModal.tsx uses a type cast (values.mediaType as 'image'|'gif'|'video'|'audio') for the form string value — standard and safe given the controlled input constraints.

concurrency.proof: No actor isolation concerns (Node single-threaded). debounce with clearTimeout cleanup in createPersistenceMiddleware. No floating promises (all async thunks awaited or dispatch-returned). createAsyncThunk lifecycle drives startHeadToHead/finishHeadToHead. No shared mutable state outside Redux store. No source-backed behavior-preserving improvement identifiable.

simplicity.proof: F-002 resolved loop 1: clearDeferredPairs unused import removed; require() ceremony eliminated. F-003 resolved loop 2: 4 parallel URL fields on Item deleted (net deletion). createItem: 12 lines → 6 lines. getItemMediaType: 10 lines → 1 line. itemHasMedia: 3 lines → 1 line. onFileDrop: 8 lines → 3 lines. onItemMediaDrop: eliminated triple-clear pattern.
simplicity.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: headToHead.ts ~1356 lines — passes deletion test (core algorithm, not decomposable further without losing locality); accepted.

test_strategy.proof: 238 → 239 tests across 34+ suites (loop 1 added persistenceMiddleware.test for onboarding seam). Loop 2: 6 test files updated to assert on item.media?.type/url instead of old parallel fields. All 239 pass post-loop-2. Impossible-state construction no longer possible in tests or production code.

test_strategy.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: No Playwright E2E tests cover the ItemMedia rendering paths — acceptable; unit tests cover the discriminated union exhaustively.

credibility.proof: F-001 loop 1: reducer-body I/O (honesty leak) removed. F-002 loop 1: dynamic require() (honesty leak) removed. F-003 loop 2: impossible multi-URL type combinations eliminated. No open findings. 239/239 tests pass. No magic numbers, no dead code branches on Item media access.

strengths: Wilson-score CI with warm-start pairings (headToHead.ts) — real algorithm depth, not scaffolding
createPersistenceMiddleware injectable Storage seam — testable without global mocks, covers all slices post-loop-1
createSelector memoization throughout selectors.ts — no inline selector functions
createAppStore factory with preloadedState + persistenceMiddleware overrides — test isolation without touching globals
ItemMedia discriminated union — impossible multi-URL state eliminated at the type level; simplifies every reader site

findings.title: onboardingSlice reducer-body localStorage I/O
findings.why_it_matters: Redux reducers must be pure functions. localStorage I/O in reducer bodies breaks time-travel debugging, server rendering, and test isolation. It also pulls ownership out of the established persistence seam.
findings.what_is_wrong: loadInitialState() called at module load (ambient dependency); completeOnboarding, skipOnboarding, resetOnboarding reducers called localStorage.setItem/removeItem directly.
evidence: packages/state/src/onboardingSlice.ts:24 — loadInitialState() localStorage.getItem at module load
findings.why_weakens_submission: Demonstrates misunderstanding of Redux invariants; undermines trust in other reducers
findings.minimal_correction_path: Remove loadInitialState(), STORAGE_KEY, all localStorage.* from reducer bodies; extend createPersistenceMiddleware persistedState to include onboarding key

findings.title: dynamic require() for vote; unused clearDeferredPairs import
findings.why_it_matters: require() inside an ESM module with top-level imports is a mixing of module systems; it bypasses tree-shaking and signals either a workaround for a circular dependency or inattention. Unused imports are noise.
findings.what_is_wrong: require('@tiercade/core') called inside thunk body at runtime rather than using the static import already at top. clearDeferredPairs imported but never referenced.
evidence: packages/state/src/headToHeadThunks.ts:17 — clearDeferredPairs imported but never used
findings.why_weakens_submission: Signals module-system confusion; adds noise to import graph
findings.minimal_correction_path: Remove dynamic require(); use already-present static import. Remove unused clearDeferredPairs import.

findings.title: Item allows impossible multi-URL combinations
findings.why_it_matters: If an Item can simultaneously have imageUrl, videoUrl, audioUrl, and mediaType set, reader sites must branch defensively and test coverage cannot prove impossible states are excluded. A discriminated union makes impossible states unrepresentable at compile time.
findings.what_is_wrong: Item interface exposed imageUrl?, videoUrl?, audioUrl?, mediaType? as independent optional fields alongside an ItemMedia discriminated union — allowing any combination.
evidence: packages/core/src/models.ts:17-28 — four independent URL fields on Item
filtering.ts:getItemMediaType — 10-line switch/case checking each field independently
apps/web/src/hooks/useItemForm.ts — three-branch if/else checking videoUrl, audioUrl, imageUrl separately
apps/web/src/hooks/useItemInteraction.ts — triple-clear pattern (item.videoUrl=undefined, item.audioUrl=undefined) before setting new URL
findings.metric_signal: impossible state representable; defensive branching at every read site
findings.why_weakens_submission: Type system not carrying its weight; each new reader must re-derive which fields are set
findings.minimal_correction_path: Replace four parallel fields with media?: ItemMedia; update all 18 reader/writer sites mechanically
findings.blast_radius: packages/core/src/models.ts, packages/core/src/filtering.ts, packages/core/src/modelResolver.ts, packages/ui/src/tier-board/TierRow.tsx, packages/ui/src/tier-board/TierBoard.tsx, packages/ui/src/components/StreamingOverlay.tsx, apps/web/src/hooks/useItemForm.ts, apps/web/src/hooks/useItemInteraction.ts, apps/web/src/components/ItemModal.tsx, apps/web/src/hooks/useExportHandlers.ts, apps/web/src/utils/urlSharing.ts, apps/web/src/pages/HeadToHeadPage.tsx, plus 6 test files

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: F-003 fix is net deletion: 4 fields removed from Item, ~40 lines removed across reader sites. Passes deletion test — every removed line was conditional branching required only because impossible states were possible.
simplification_check.new_seam_justified: No new seam created. ItemMedia union already existed in models.ts; fix moves it from documentation-only to enforced.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: createItem 12→6 lines. getItemMediaType 10→1 line. itemHasMedia 3→1 line. onFileDrop 8→3 lines. onItemMediaDrop eliminated triple-clear pattern. All subtractive.
simplification_check.should_not_do: Do not add a separate ItemMediaValidator class. Do not make Item a class. Do not add runtime validation middleware for ItemMedia.

builder_notes: Discriminated union at the type level is the correct tool for mutually exclusive variants. If a field combination is impossible, the type must make it impossible — not comments or factory policy.
Reducer body I/O smell: any localStorage.*, fetch(), setTimeout() inside createSlice.reducers.* body must move to middleware or thunks.
Dynamic require() inside ESM: always use top-level static import instead.
narrative: Strong contender. The H2H algorithm (Wilson-score CI, warm-start pairings), injectable-storage middleware, and memoized selector graph were the structural anchors from the start. Loop 1 eliminated the two execution-correctness findings (reducer-body I/O, dynamic require()). Loop 2 closed the domain-modeling gap: impossible multi-URL Item state is now unrepresentable at the type level, and every reader site became simpler as a result. All 9 dimensions at 9.5. No open findings. HALT_SUCCESS.

loop_result.what_changed: Replaced Item.imageUrl/videoUrl/audioUrl/mediaType (4 parallel optional fields) with Item.media?: ItemMedia discriminated union (F-003 resolved). Updated all 18 reader/writer sites including 12 source files and 6 test files.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: 239/239 tests pass post-loop-2 (0 failures, 0 skips). net deletion: ~40 lines removed, ~25 lines added (simplified reader sites). TypeScript strict mode: no new type assertions except one safe cast in ItemModal.tsx form string. Old parallel URL fields fully absent from codebase.

implementation_review.reason: Reality check: F-003 fields (imageUrl, videoUrl, audioUrl, mediaType) absent from Item interface in current models.ts; media?: ItemMedia present. Honesty check: 239/239 tests pass; no test assertions on old fields; new assertions on media?.type and media?.url. Regression check: no pre-existing test broke; no new skips or xfails introduced.
